leftEvidence.title: Jesus touches a man who asks to be made clean

points.label: Cleansing setting and claim
points.left: A man asks Jesus to make him clean.
points.right: A man is cleansed after Jesus touches him, then is directed toward priestly testimony.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: touch, cleansing, silence, priestly showing, Moses’ offering follow.
points.right: A man is cleansed after Jesus touches him, then is directed toward priestly testimony.

payload.posture: Matthew and Mark preserve the same core encounter while selecting distinct aftermath details.

rightEvidence.title: A cleansed man makes the scene widely known

payload.tension: Matthew foregrounds Moses’ offering as testimony; Mark foregrounds the man’s publicity and Jesus remaining outside.
payload.title: Two witnesses to the cleansing of a man
